meanings.usage: 指具有历史价值的古老物件
修饰和古董相关的事物
可形容事物独有的特性，也可指反常的、怪异的
常和介词for/over搭配，表示对…的吸引力
形容少见、珍贵的事物，也可形容稀薄的空气

meanings.meaning: 令人生畏的，望而却步的
meanings.usage: 常用来形容地方、外表或者氛围给人严肃、不易接近的感觉
常见搭配muster up courage表示鼓起勇气
形容人或事物刻意显得贵重、重要，实际名不副实
可指实际的迷宫类建筑，也可比喻复杂难懂的结构
形容长期不通风、潮湿的地方或物品散发的味道
指稀有的、有价值的物品，也可指稀有性
形容不同种类的物品混合在一起
形容人对某件事投入大量精力、非常专注
修饰回报、证明等词，表示程度充足
描述做某事时不情愿的状态
形容比正常尺寸小很多的事物

phrases.usage: 表示对…产生吸引力，主语通常是具有魅力的事物

examples.en: Ancient cities exert a peculiar fascination on tourists from all over the world.
examples.zh: 古城对来自世界各地的游客有着独特的吸引力。

phrases.usage: 表示使某物远离…、免受…的影响

examples.en: We should keep the laboratory free from dust and noise.
examples.zh: 我们应该让实验室远离灰尘和噪音。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，意为鼓起勇气做某事，后面常接to do不定式

examples.en: She mustered up courage to give a speech in front of hundreds of people.
examples.zh: 她鼓起勇气在数百人面前发表演讲。

phrases.usage: 表示偶然、意外地，相当于accidentally，在句中作状语

examples.en: I met my former classmate by chance in the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在超市偶然碰到了我以前的同学。

phrases.usage: 插入语，意为最重要的是，用于强调后续内容的重要性

examples.en: To be a good nurse, you need to be careful, patient and above all, kind to patients.
examples.zh: 要成为一名好护士，你需要细心、有耐心，最重要的是要对病人友善。

phrases.usage: 表示一心想要、决心要，后面接名词或动名词，常指下定决心做某事

examples.en: He is bent on winning the first prize in the national English competition.
examples.zh: 他一心想要在全国英语竞赛中获得一等奖。

phrases.usage: 此处表示轻易买到、便宜买到，还可表示捡起、学会（语言）、接人等含义

examples.en: She picked up a beautiful vintage dress at the second-hand market for only 100 yuan.
examples.zh: 她在二手市场只花了100元就买到了一件漂亮的复古连衣裙。

phrases.phrase: be about to do sth when
phrases.usage: 表示正要做某事，这时突然发生另一件事，强调动作的突发性

examples.en: I was about to go out when the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 我正要出门，这时电话铃响了。

phrases.phrase: cannot be bothered to do sth
phrases.usage: 表示懒得做某事，不想费心做某事，是口语中常用的表达

examples.en: After a long day at work, I can't be bothered to cook dinner.
examples.zh: 工作了一整天之后，我懒得做晚饭了。

phrases.usage: 表示除了…之外，相当于except for或者besides，根据语境可表示排除或者包含关系

examples.en: Apart from a few spelling mistakes, your composition is very good.
examples.zh: 除了几个拼写错误之外，你的作文写得非常好。

sentences.en: Antique shops exert a peculiar fascination on a great many people.
sentences.zh: 古玩店对许多人来说都有一种特殊的魅力。

sentences.en: The more expensive kind of antique shop where rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases
sentences.zh: 那些高档古玩店，珍品都漂亮地陈列在玻璃柜里

sentences.en: to keep them free from dust is usually a forbidding place.
sentences.zh: 以免沾染灰尘，通常是令人望而却步的地方。

sentences.en: But no one has to muster up courage to enter a less pretentious antique shop.
sentences.zh: 但对于不那么做作的古玩店，人们无需鼓起勇气进去。

sentences.en: There is always hope that in its labyrinth of musty, dark, disordered rooms a real rarity will be found amongst the piles of assorted junk that litter the floors.
sentences.zh: 人们总是希望在那些发霉、阴暗、杂乱的房间构成的迷宫中，能在堆满地板的各式各样的旧货中找到一件真正的珍品。

sentences.en: No one discovers a rarity by chance.
sentences.zh: 没有人会偶然发现珍品。

sentences.en: A truly dedicated bargain hunter must have patience,
sentences.zh: 一个真正专注的廉价商品搜寻者必须有耐心，

sentences.en: and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something when he sees it.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，当他看到一件东西时，要有识别其价值的能力。

sentences.en: To do this, he must be at least as knowledgeable as the dealer.
sentences.zh: 为此，他必须至少和经销商一样知识渊博。

sentences.en: Like a scientist bent on making a discovery,
sentences.zh: 就像一个决心有所发现的科学家一样，

sentences.en: he must cherish the hope that one day he will be amply rewarded.
sentences.zh: 他必须怀揣希望，总有一天他会得到丰厚的回报。

sentences.en: My old friend, Frank Halliday, is just such a person.
sentences.zh: 我的老朋友弗兰克·哈利迪就是这样一个人。

sentences.en: He has often described to me how he picked up a masterpiece for a mere ￡50.
sentences.zh: 他常常向我描述他是如何以区区50英镑买到一件杰作的。

sentences.en: One Saturday morning, Frank visited an antique shop in my neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 一个星期六的上午，弗兰克去了我附近的一家古玩店。

sentences.en: As he had never been there before, he found a great deal to interest him.
sentences.zh: 因为他以前从未来过这里，所以发现了很多让他感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: The morning passed rapidly and Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
sentences.zh: 上午很快过去了，弗兰克正准备离开时，他注意到地板上放着一个大包装箱。

sentences.en: The dealer told him that it had just come in, but that he could not be bothered to open it.
sentences.zh: 经销商告诉他，这东西刚到，但他懒得打开。

sentences.en: Frank begged him to do so and the dealer reluctantly prised it open.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克恳求他打开，经销商不情愿地撬开了箱子。

sentences.en: The contents were disappointing.
sentences.zh: 里面的东西令人失望。

sentences.en: Apart from an interesting-looking carved dagger, the box was full of crockery, much of it broken.
sentences.zh: 除了一个看起来有趣的雕花匕首外，箱子里装满了陶器，其中大部分都碎了。

sentences.en: Frank gently lifted the crockery out of the box and suddenly noticed a miniature painting at the bottom of the packing case.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克轻轻地把陶器从箱子里拿出来，突然注意到包装箱底部有一幅微型画。

sentences.en: As its composition and line reminded him of an Italian painting he knew well, he decided to buy it.
sentences.zh: 由于它的构图和线条让他想起了他很熟悉的一幅意大利画作，他决定买下它。

sentences.en: Glancing at it briefly the dealer told him that it was worth ￡50.
sentences.zh: 经销商匆匆看了一眼，告诉他这幅画值50英镑。

sentences.en: Frank could hardly conceal his excitement, for he knew that he had made a real discovery.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克几乎无法掩饰他的兴奋，因为他知道他做了一个真正的发现。

sentences.en: The tiny painting proved to be an unknown masterpiece by Correggio and was worth hundreds and thousands of pounds.
sentences.zh: 这幅小画被证实是科雷吉奥的一幅不为人知的杰作，价值数十万英镑。

grammar.title: The + 比较级结构作定语
grammar.definition: 用"the + 形容词比较级"修饰名词，表示两类事物中程度更高的那一类，隐含和另一类的对比关系
grammar.structure: The + 形容词比较级 + 名词 + 定语从句/其他修饰成分
grammar.usage: 用于对同一范畴的两个事物进行对比，突出其中程度更高的那个的属性

examples.en: The more expensive kind of antique shop where rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases to keep them free from dust is usually a forbidding place.
examples.zh: 高档一点的古玩店为了防尘，把文物漂亮地陈列在玻璃柜子里，那里往往令人望而却步。

examples.en: The more convenient way to get to the airport is to take the high-speed rail.
examples.zh: 去机场更便捷的方式是坐高铁。

grammar.title: There is hope that 同位语从句
grammar.definition: that引导的从句作名词hope的同位语，用来解释说明hope的具体内容
grammar.structure: There is hope that + 完整的陈述句式从句
grammar.usage: 用于表达某种可能性是存在的，人们抱有相关的期望

examples.en: There is always hope that in its labyrinth of musty, dark, disordered rooms a real rarity will be found amongst the piles of assorted junk that litter the floors.
examples.zh: 人们还常常有希望在发霉、阴暗、杂乱无章、迷宫般的店堂里，从杂乱地摆放在地面上的、一堆堆各式各样的破烂货里找到一件稀世珍品。

examples.en: There is hope that the team will win the championship this season.
examples.zh: 这支队伍有望在本赛季赢得冠军。

patterns.pattern: A truly dedicated + 名词 + must have..., and above all, the ability to...

original.en: A truly dedicated bargain hunter must have patience, and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something when he sees it.
original.zh: 一个一心一意找便宜货的人必须有耐心，最重要的是，要有眼力，看到东西就能认出它的价值。

examples.en: A truly dedicated writer must have rich life experience, and above all, the ability to observe small details in daily life.
examples.zh: 一个真正专注的作家必须有丰富的人生阅历，最重要的是，要有观察生活中微小细节的能力。

examples.en: A truly dedicated researcher must have rigorous academic attitude, and above all, the ability to think independently.
examples.zh: 一个真正专注的研究者必须有严谨的学术态度，最重要的是，要有独立思考的能力。

patterns.pattern: Sb could hardly conceal his/her + 情绪名词, for he/she knew that...

original.en: Frank could hardly conceal his excitement, for he knew that he had made a real discovery.
original.zh: 弗兰克几乎无法掩饰自己兴奋的心情，因为他知道自己有了一个真正的发现。

examples.en: She could hardly conceal her disappointment, for she knew that she had failed the interview she had prepared for months.
examples.zh: 她几乎无法掩饰自己的失望，因为她知道自己准备了数月的面试没有通过。

examples.en: The little boy could hardly conceal his joy, for he knew that his parents would take him to the Disneyland this weekend.
examples.zh: 小男孩几乎无法掩饰自己的喜悦，因为他知道父母这周末要带他去迪士尼乐园。

patterns.pattern: As + 原因状语从句, sb decided to do sth

original.en: As its composition and line reminded him of an Italian painting he knew well, he decided to buy it.
original.zh: 由于它的构图和线条让他想起了一幅他熟悉的意大利画作，他决定买下它。

examples.en: As the weather forecast said it would rain heavily in the afternoon, we decided to cancel the outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 由于天气预报说下午会下大雨，我们决定取消户外野餐。

examples.en: As the course he wanted to take was very popular, he decided to sign up for it as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 由于他想选的那门课非常热门，他决定尽快报名。
